resources.string: This chat will appear only in Hidden chats. Its notifications will be hidden on this device. Messages remain in your Telegram account.
Move this chat back to the normal chat list?
Choose a separate password of 4–256 characters and confirm it. This password cannot be recovered. Hiding applies only on this device; it does not encrypt messages or hide them in other Telegram apps.
Enter the separate password for hidden chats.
Enter your current password, then set and confirm a new password.
No hidden chats yet. Tap Add chat to choose one.
Long press a chat to unhide it. Hidden chats lock when the app goes into the background.
Strong biometric authentication is not available. Set up fingerprint or face authentication in your device settings, then try again.
You can enter your password to continue.
All hidden chats will return to the normal list. Your messages will remain. Enter your password in the next step to confirm.
Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
Could not save or read hidden chats settings. Try again.
Hidden chats settings could not be read. Chats remain protected. Restore the app data from a trusted backup.
Hidden chats were locked. Enter your password again.
